narrative_purpose: Teaches the ocean's faster thermostat: heat-stressed plankton vent a sulphur compound that rises and seeds bright clouds, which reflect sunlight and cool the sea that warmed the plankton — life reaching up to adjust the planet's own albedo.
subject: A vertical loop diagram over a stretch of ocean. At the bottom, sunlit surface water with a faint bloom of tiny glowing plankton. From the bloom, thin wisps rise into the air and gather into a deck of bright, dense white cloud across the upper third. From the cloud, broad pale beams of reflected light bounce back upward toward the sky. A curved return path runs down the side from the cooled sea back to the plankton, showing the cycle closing on itself.
scene: A side-on slice of ocean and sky: glowing plankton in the water below, rising sulphur wisps, a reflective cloud deck above, sunlight bouncing off it.
camera: A side-on diagrammatic cross-section of sea and sky, the full vertical loop in frame.
light: Even diagrammatic light; the plankton bloom and the bright cloud deck picked out in cool glow, the reflected beams pale, the deep water dim.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal water, the plankton and cloud in Pandora cyan and pale luminous white, restrained.
style: Painterly speculative-science naturalist plate with strong diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the plankton bloom, the rising wisps and the bright cloud deck; soft in the deep water and sky margins.
composition: A clear vertical stack — plankton low, wisps rising, cloud deck high, reflected light bouncing up — with the return path down one side, dark margins for labels.
consistency_notes: Pure Earth-science figure in the book's cool palette so it sits beside the Pandoran plates. The single baked-in return-path curve is allowed because the loop is the subject; no other arrows, no text. Leave dark sky and water margins for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no chemical formulae, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
